title: REQ · Executions run in an isolated worktree with timeout, retry, budget, approval gate and structured reports
summary: Runner orchestrating lock, worktree, agent attempts, budget and approval, writing reports
description: Context: builds on lock and state packages. Desired behavior: runner.Runner.Run acquires the World lock, creates a worktree through a Worktrees interface, calls an Agent per attempt under a context timeout, retries failures up to MaxRetries, stops when cumulative cost reaches MaxBudgetUSD, then sets AWAITING_APPROVAL; Publish refuses until the record is APPROVED unless auto_publish. A report JSON is written to development/executions/<id>.report.json. Why: safe, bounded, supervised development.
acceptance_criteria: Given the lock is already held, when Run is called, then it returns lock.ErrLocked and no worktree is created
Given an agent that blocks past ExecTimeout on the fake clock-driven context, when Run runs, then the attempt fails with a timeout error and is retried
Given an agent failing every time, when Run runs with MaxRetries 2, then exactly 3 attempts are made and the record is FAILED
Given attempts whose cost reaches MaxBudgetUSD, when Run runs, then ErrBudgetExceeded is returned and no further attempt starts
Given a successful attempt, when Run ends, then status is AWAITING_APPROVAL and Publish returns ErrNotApproved until approved; the worktree is always removed
Given any outcome, then a structured report with attempts, cost, status and error exists under development/executions
technical_constraints: Agent interface: Run(ctx, workDir, prompt string) (costUSD float64, output string, err error); Worktrees interface: Add(ctx, path, branch, baseRef) error and Remove(ctx, path) error
non_functional: Worktree removal runs on a non-cancelled context
